overview.summary: One authority for the runtime working directory: an injected runtimeCwd reaches every repository-scoped site, and _local has one answer.

stories.name: Runtime cwd single authority

verified.summary: cd packages/dartclaw_runtime && dart test --run-skipped --reporter=failures-only test/integration/container_provider_parity_integration_test.dart --name "production acquisition pins each workspace" -> exit=0, +1: All tests passed!

stories.scope: Route DartclawRuntime.runtimeCwd to every runtime site that means the runtime's repository (harness spawn cwd, behavior files, model-catalogue probe, container /project mount, server mount roots) and make it the _local project's directory; require the directory on repository-scoped constructors; name and justify the remaining process-cwd reads.
